answer: Lagoon-anchored liveness ledger. Each agent identity must cite a fresh, verifier-signed observation of a random spot in a seeded lagoon simulation, plus a ripple of downstream state changes only that spot could produce. Answers cannot be cached or reused, since seeds rotate per epoch and prior responses fail replay checks. The vine of valid citations grows one branch per agent. Attackers pay compute plus real-time simulation cost per identity per epoch, making mass fabrication linear in wall-clock work.
